text:
incident-bot: ALERT: PagerDuty incident GPU_CUDA_ALLOC_FAILURE fired for service gpu-serving-west2. Severity: P2. Affected pool: gpu-prod-west2. Error: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation during KV cache eviction.

pagerduty: Triggered by alloc_fail_rate > 0.05 over 1m. Link: https://pagerduty.redwood.ai/incidents/PD12345 :rotating_light:

alice_oncall: Acked — I'm taking this. Will triage node gpu-w2-07 first.

ben_sre: Noted. Logs show repeated "malloc returned NULL" in infer-82 container on gpu-w2-07, plus eviction churn in kvcache.

alice_oncall: Taking gpu-w2-07 OOB, draining it now.
```
kubectl drain gpu-w2-07 --ignore-daemonsets --force
kubectl get pods -o wide | grep infer-82
# tail -n 50 /var/log/inference/runtime.log | grep -i alloc
# observed: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation at kv_cache_evict
```

ops-bot: Scaling request submitted: scale gpu-prod-west2 by +2 nodes (requested via autoscaler API).

sri_ml: We're triggering immediate routing fallback for high-latency/error routes: redwood-7b-q4 -> redwood-3b-q4f for customers flagged as sensitive. Patching router rules now.

ben_sre: Customer impact estimate: /v1/generate error rate ~18% in west2 for last 5m, latency p99 > 5s. Likely affecting acme:prod, tutorly:prod, summaries-inc:search. Not a complete outage but significant degradations.

alice_oncall: Mitigation steps executed: forced KV cache flush on node, restarted inference-runtime, bumped kvcache_limit 2GB -> 4GB temporarily.
```
sudo systemctl restart inference-runtime
# post-restart check
journalctl -u inference-runtime -n 200 | tail -n 50
# observed: allocator reconnected, no malloc failures for 30s
```

pagerduty: Escalation policy active — escalate to oncall-senior if not resolved in 15m.

carl_arch: Creating short-term dashboard for KV churn and allocator OOM trends, will link to the incident. Opening postmortem runbook page.

alice_oncall: Confirming improvement: alloc failures dropping, error rate now ~1.2%, latency returning to baseline. Keeping monitoring window open 30m.

ben_sre: Follow-ups: adjust autoscaler to maintain +1 spare GPU per zone, add prefetch backpressure guard to kvcache, and add tighter alerting thresholds for kv eviction rate.

alice_oncall: Marking incident PD12345 as mitigated. Will file a postmortem and schedule RCA with ML infra next week. Postmortem owner: ben_sre.

incident-bot: UPDATE: PagerDuty incident PD12345 resolved/modeled as mitigated. Please ensure postmortem filed within 48h: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/PD12345 :white_check_mark:

alice_oncall: Thanks team. Short notes for follow-up: collect pre/post heap profiles from gpu-w2-07, preserve evicted KV cache shards for analysis, and validate fallback routing didn't cause quality regressions for affected customers.

ben_sre: I'll open the follow-up ticket and assign tests for fallback quality checks.

carl_arch: Adding a scheduled run of the kvcache stress test to CI to try to reproduce.

alice_oncall: Closing thread here — monitoring continues. Ping if regressions occur. :thumbsup:
